Green Bay, Wisconsin · 10-minute walk to Lambeau

Welcome to the Lombardi House

The Lombardi House is where Pigskin Journeyman began. Coming out of a lifetime spent playing football, I first imagined this home as a way to tell my own story. The basement gave 27 jerseys and a career’s worth of memorabilia a place beyond the closet in my childhood home. But once guests began walking through the door, we realized the idea was bigger than any one career. Pigskin Journeyman could bring the game’s history to life where it happened, celebrate the greats tied to each football community, and invite every guest to leave behind a little of their own story. That discovery set us on the journey to create more homes at the sport’s most meaningful destinations. Here in the Lombardi neighborhood, steps from Lambeau Field, we hope you find the stories that shaped this place and create a few new ones of your own.

Matthew, Paulinha, Koa and Rio

Amenities

Settle in and play
Kitchen and coffee

Start the morning right

The dishwasher and oven work like any standard ones. The coffee station has a drip coffee maker and an electric kettle for tea and pour over. We set out Pilao ground coffee for guests, which is what my Brazilian in-laws swear by, so we put it in all of our houses. A decaf option is there too. You will also find EmergenC in the coffee area in case anyone could use an immune boost after rough travels.

Hot tub

Seven seats, jets and blowers

The Emerald Spas hexagon tub stays on at 101F and can go up to 104F. Guests never need to shut it off when they leave.

Cooler than expected? It was likely reset to vacation or econ mode. Switch it back to standard, or reach out and we will help.
Private cinema

One remote, 100-inch screen

The projector runs Google TV, so it is standalone with a single remote and no extra boxes to juggle. Streaming includes NFL+ Premium, Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, and Amazon Prime.

Game room

Bring your best game

The garage game room has QB Pass Attack, Pop-A-Shot, foosball, and darts. The arcade cabinet holds more than 2,500 classic games. We keep house record boards for Pop-A-Shot and love to have guests try to qualify, so take your shot at the board.

Please turn the arcade OFF using the directions on the unit itself before cutting power at the wall.

Good to Know

The details worth finding

Heating and cooling

The Amazon thermostat adjusts right on the unit. The snowflake icon is A/C and the fire icon is heat. The whole house fan can be adjusted as well.

Hidden locker room

Pull the Murphy bookshelf open to find our tribute to four generations of Green Bay quarterbacks. The custom lockers trace the lineage that inspired this secret room.

Gridiron Guests collage

We ask our guests to share a picture from when they played football so we can add it to our Gridiron Guests collage for the season. In exchange you get free box candy and a cinema drink.

Outdoors

The smokeless fire pit is ready to go with firewood provided in the shed. Outside you will also find a propane grill and a Blackstone. Please be considerate of the guests who follow you and clean up after yourselves. The house sits across from a city park, perfect for a morning walk.

Local Recommendations

Where we send friends

Our favorite spots around Green Bay, from game day classics a short walk away to the practical stops every group ends up needing. Hours, seasons, and game day schedules change, so it is worth confirming details before you head out.

Matt's Picks

A note from Matt: These are my own favorites, the places I point guests to when they want a real Green Bay meal or something worth bringing back to the house. If you only try three local spots during your stay, start here.

Matt's PickThe Booyah Shed1800 S Ashland Ave, Green Bay, WI

My booyah spot. This family-run comfort place serves slow-simmered Green Bay booyah stew, and the truck still shows up at events near Lambeau.

Matt's PickSammy's Pizza & Italian Restaurant2161 S Oneida St, Green Bay, WI

The pizza place on Oneida is a total blast from the past. Family owned since 1958, it serves thin-crust pizza in an old-school dining room.

Matt's PickScray Cheese2082 Old Martin Rd, De Pere, WI

Where to get real fresh, squeaky cheese curds. This fourth-generation family cheese factory also lets you watch cheese being made.

Restaurants

Kroll's West1990 S. Ridge Road, Ashwaubenon

Lambeau's longtime neighbor across the street since 1974, famous for charcoal grilled butter burgers, booyah soup, and deep fried cheese curds.

Hinterland Brewery and Restaurant1001 Lombardi Ave, Green Bay

Locally brewed craft beer and locally raised food in a big lodge style space across from Lambeau Field.

Stadium View1963 Holmgren Way, Ashwaubenon

Green Bay's largest sports bar with 70+ TVs, a rooftop Sky Bar, and a famous cheese curd flight, about a six minute walk from Lambeau.

1919 Kitchen and Tap1265 Lombardi Ave, Green Bay (inside the Lambeau Field Atrium)

Upscale sports bar inside the Lambeau Field Atrium serving elevated pub cuisine; reservations recommended.

Margarita's Mexican1241 Lombardi Access Road, Ashwaubenon

Popular, family friendly Mexican restaurant within walking distance of the stadium district.

Union Hotel and Restaurant200 N Broadway St, De Pere

Historic supper club older than the Packers themselves; the team's iconic G logo was designed here and coaches back to Curly Lambeau dined here.

Bars and breweries

Titletown Brewing Company200 Dousman St, Green Bay

Green Bay's original craft brewery since 1996, with a rooftop Sky Lounge overlooking the river and house brews like the "400" Honey Ale.

Stillmank Brewing Company215 N Henry St, Green Bay

Dog friendly taproom with a wide rotating tap list and a laid back vibe on Green Bay's downtown east side.

Copper State Brewing Co313 Dousman St, Green Bay

Family owned craft brewery, gastropub, and coffee shop in historic downtown, known for wood fired pizza and acclaimed hazy IPAs.

D2 Sports Pub788 Armed Forces Drive, Ashwaubenon

Game day sports bar steps from Lambeau Field with 50+ TVs, solid wings and burgers, a patio, and late night hours.

Breakfast and coffee

The Pancake Place143 S. Military Ave, Green Bay

Classic Green Bay breakfast spot and one of the area's most popular game day morning destinations, known for huge pancake stacks.

The Creamery Downtown114 Pine St, Green Bay

Creative American breakfast and lunch with river views and coffee from local roaster Terra Verde.

Kavarna Coffeehouse143 N Broadway, Green Bay

Historic multi level coffeehouse in the Broadway District serving its own roasted coffee, with a vegetarian friendly menu.

Grocery and essentials

Festival Foods2250 W Mason St, Green Bay

Family owned Wisconsin grocery chain with bakery, deli, produce, and beer and wine, open daily 6am to 11pm and about a 5 to 10 minute drive from the house.

Football and sports attractions

Lambeau Field Stadium Tours1265 Lombardi Ave, Green Bay (Lambeau Field Atrium)

Guided tours of Lambeau Field with stops in the player tunnel and other exclusive areas; book online up to 30 days ahead.

Packers Hall of Fame1265 Lombardi Ave, Green Bay (Lambeau Field Atrium)

The first hall of fame built to honor a single professional football team, with trophies, interactive exhibits, and team history.

Packers Heritage TrailDowntown Green Bay, starting near Washington and Cherry Streets

Self guided walking and biking trail with 25 bronze plaques at historic Packers sites; the City Walk is about 4.5 miles.

Titletown1025 Lombardi Ave, Green Bay

45 acre Packers developed park and event district west of Lambeau Field, with a football field, playground, tubing hill, and beer garden.

Family and outdoor activities

Bay Beach Amusement Park1313 Bay Beach Rd, Green Bay

Historic amusement park on the bay with 25 cent ride tickets, the century old Zippin Pippin wooden coaster, and classic family rides.

Bay Beach Wildlife Sanctuary1660 E Shore Dr, Green Bay

600 acre urban wildlife refuge with live animal exhibits, a rehabilitation program, and miles of hiking trails; free admission.

The Children's Museum of Green Bay1230 Bay Beach Rd, Green Bay

Hands on children's museum across from Bay Beach with interactive exhibits and an outdoor discovery center, about $8 per person.

Practical

Walgreens (nearest pharmacy)2301 S Oneida St, Ashwaubenon

Full service pharmacy with vaccinations and everyday essentials, open daily 7am to 11pm and roughly a mile or so from the house.

Bellin Health Urgent Care1630 Commanche Ave, Ashwaubenon

Full urgent care center open 7 days a week, 8am to 8pm, run by Bellin Health, the official healthcare partner of the Packers.

Check-out

Before 11:00 AM

A few things our cleaners appreciate, not a chore list. If you are short on time, do not worry about any of this.

  1. Leave beds unmade, no need to strip them
  2. Put used towels in the shower
  3. Load and start the dishwasher
  4. Empty the trash
  5. Return furniture and items to their places
  6. Set the climate controls appropriately
  7. Lock the doors and windows

Thanks for staying with us

Thank you for staying with us at the Lombardi House. We hope the house gave you a few stories worth retelling. Come back anytime.

Matthew, Paulinha, Koa and Rio
